findings.title: [Spoofing] Client Identity Spoofing & Broken Auth Token Validation in API Gateway / Reverse Proxy
findings.description:
Adversary sends forged JWTs or replayed credentials to bypass identity verification.
Impact: Unauthorized access to internal endpoints as another authenticated entity.
findings.mitigation: Recommended Mitigation: Enforce strict RS256/ES256 asymmetric signature verification, short-lived tokens, and jti revocation list.
findings.impact: Risk rating: HIGH. Requires remediation per SLA within 14 days.

findings.title: [Tampering] Data Tampering via Unparameterized Input or Missing State Integrity in Primary Database Store
findings.description:
Untrusted parameters injected into application layer alter database records or transactions.
Impact: Data corruption, financial loss, or unauthorized record modifications.
findings.mitigation: Recommended Mitigation: Enforce strict ORM parameterized queries, row-level integrity checks, and least-privilege DB credentials.
findings.impact: Risk rating: CRITICAL. Requires remediation per SLA within 7 days.

findings.title: [Repudiation] Insufficient Audit Trail for Critical Actions & State Transitions in Backend Application Server
findings.description:
Sensitive administrative changes, balance transfers, or permission grants occur without immutable logging.
Impact: Inability to hold malicious actors accountable or reconstruct incident forensics.
findings.mitigation: Recommended Mitigation: Implement structured tamper-evident security logging with user IDs, timestamps, client IPs, and append-only log sinks.
findings.impact: Risk rating: MEDIUM. Requires remediation per SLA within 30 days.

findings.title: [Information Disclosure] Sensitive Data Leakage via Error Stack Traces and Verbose Headers in API Gateway / Reverse Proxy
findings.description:
Production endpoints return unhandled exception stack traces, environment variables, or database schemas.
Impact: Exposes internal system topology, library versions, and credentials to potential attackers.
findings.mitigation: Recommended Mitigation: Sanitize all error responses, disable debug mode in production, and remove Server/X-Powered-By banners.
findings.impact: Risk rating: HIGH. Requires remediation per SLA within 14 days.

findings.title: [Denial of Service] Application Resource Exhaustion via Unthrottled Endpoints (API4) in Backend Application Server
findings.description:
Expensive queries, file uploads, or cryptographic hashing endpoints lack rate limiting and concurrency caps.
Impact: Service outage, thread pool depletion, and cloud billing spike.
findings.mitigation: Recommended Mitigation: Implement IP and token-based rate limiting (e.g. token bucket in Redis), strict request body size limits, and timeouts.
findings.impact: Risk rating: HIGH. Requires remediation per SLA within 14 days.

findings.title: [Elevation of Privilege] Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA / IDOR) in Backend Application Server
findings.description:
Endpoint does not verify if the requesting authenticated user owns or has rights to the requested resource ID.
Impact: Tenants can read or modify sensitive data belonging to other organizations or administrators.
findings.mitigation: Recommended Mitigation: Implement centralized context-aware authorization checks on every data access query (e.g. user_id = current_user.id).
findings.impact: Risk rating: CRITICAL. Requires remediation per SLA within 7 days.

findings.title: [ASVS V7.1.1] Non-compliant: Verify that debug mode and verbose stack traces are disabled in produc...
findings.description:
OWASP ASVS Requirement V7.1.1 (Level 1): Verify that debug mode and verbose stack traces are disabled in production deployments.
Evidence: Debug mode enabled (DEBUG=True) in server.py
findings.mitigation: Set DEBUG=False and implement standardized generic error handlers.
findings.impact: Risk rating: HIGH. Requires remediation per SLA within 14 days.
